workflow.primaryIntent: Distinguish a phone photo-library problem from a Mac disk-storage problem, not sell a phone cleaner as a Mac replacement.
outline: Identify which device and storage pool is full before selecting a tool.
Describe Cleanup's documented iPhone media/contact workflow without running deletion.

comparison.primaryIntent: A concise platform distinction, not an interchangeable-products ranking.

cleanupAdvantages: Documented iPhone-specific duplicate/similar-photo, contact-merge and video-compression tasks match phone-library intent better than a Mac maintenance app (workflow/platform claims).
Vendor documents a selection-review step; no hands-on safety guarantee inferred (approval claim).
cleanupTradeoffs: Not established as a Mac or Windows tool (platform claim).
Exact paywall/feature limits and trial renewal choice remain unclear (pricing/trial-conflict claims).
No-tracking/offline wording cannot be generalized across the app given privacy and terms disclosures (privacy-conflict claim).
breathingRoomAdvantages: For a Mac storage-investigation job, the reused register supports Mac category/app/project views and grouped process monitoring; not evidence of phone-library cleaning.
breathingRoomTradeoffs: Preview 0.1.0-preview.1; Python 3.10+, macOS 13+, no Developer ID/notarization in inspected disclosure; runtime/binary parity unproven.
Optional hosted AI needs authentication/internet; advertised AI Care $5 USD/month or $50 USD/year. Not entirely offline AI.
No established matching iPhone duplicate-photo/contact feature; do not recommend it as a drop-in phone cleaner.
